# Cornell University <span class='zh-inline'>(康奈尔大学)</span>

<img src="logos/cornell.svg" alt="Cornell University identifier" width="150" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1.4rem 0">

Founded by Ezra Cornell on the idea of 'any person ... any study', home to an early CS department and two Turing Award founders.

> 由 Ezra Cornell 本着“任何人……任何学科”的理念创办，拥有早期计算机系和两位图灵奖得主奠基人。

## Background (背景)

Founded in 1865 in Ithaca, New York, Cornell is private with a public mission; its Computer Science department was established in 1965.

> 1865 年创办于纽约州伊萨卡，是“私立而承担公共使命”的大学；计算机科学系成立于 1965 年。

## Notable people (名人)

**Juris Hartmanis** — founding CS chair (1965), co-recipient of the 1993 Turing Award for establishing computational complexity theory. **John Hopcroft** — 1986 Turing Award and co-author of the classic automata textbook. **Eva Tardos** — elected to the National Academy of Sciences in 2013 for network-flow and approximation algorithms.

> **Juris Hartmanis** — 首任计算机系主任（1965），因奠定计算复杂性理论获 1993 年图灵奖。**John Hopcroft** — 1986 年图灵奖得主，经典自动机教材合著者。**Eva Tardos** — 因网络流与近似算法于 2013 年当选美国国家科学院院士。

## Notable CS courses (著名计算机课程)

CS 1110 Introduction to Computing · CS 2110 Object-Oriented Programming and Data Structures · CS 2800 Mathematical Foundations · CS 3410 Computer System Organization · CS 4820 Analysis of Algorithms.

> CS 1110 计算导论 · CS 2110 面向对象编程与数据结构 · CS 2800 计算数学基础 · CS 3410 计算机系统组织 · CS 4820 算法分析。
